newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OLYMPICS-FIVE CITIES COMPETE FOR 2004 GAMES.
newsitem.headline: OLYMPICS-FIVE CITIES COMPETE FOR 2004 GAMES.

text.p: The International Olympic Committee on Friday drew up a final shortlist of five candidates to host the 2004 Games.
They were Athens, Buenos Aires, Cape Town, Rome and Stockholm.

The following is a brief outline of the IOC's assessment of the main strengths and weaknesses of the five short-listed cities on issues including the state of venues, facilities, accommodation, security, transport and environment.
*** ATHENS ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Excellent with 96.4 percent support

VENUES - Good conditions for most venues. Existing stadium will be updated and used as an 80,000-seat Olympic Stadium. The marathon would start on the historic side of Marathon and finish in the original marble 1896 Olympic Stadium, providing a unique historical ambiance.
FACILITIES - High-quality. Village 30 minutes from city.
ACCOMMODATION - Four-five star 6,076 rooms and cruise ships.
WEAKNESSES:
ENVIRONMENT - Possibility of high pollution due to high temperatures during the period of the Games. But government efforts have shown positive results in alleviating serious air pollution problems.
TRANSPORT - Significant problems with airport access and transportation within the city. However, major projects are underway to alleviate this situation.
BUDGET - Doubts over the $285 million in revenues budgeted.
*** BUENOS AIRES ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - 86.8 percent aware, of whom 70.8 in favour.

VENUES - Good conditions for tennis, judo, artistic gymnastics, triathlon and yachting. Also good soccer stadiums. An existing 60,000-seat stadium will be converted into a 65,000-seat Olympic Stadium.
FACILITIES - Convenient and environmentally-friendly.
ENVIRONMENT - Realistic programme and low impact on the natural environment.
WEAKNESSES:
ACCOMMODATION - Up to 50-70 percent capacity expansion needed.
TRANSPORT - International airport needs major improvement in both facilities and equipment.
BUDGET - Appears conservative and some cost estimates appear to be on the low side.
VENUES - Technical challenges for rowing and canoeing. Mountain biking venue more than four hours away from the city and should be reconsidered.
WEATHER - Possibility of rain, temperatures of 10 degrees Celsius.
*** CAPE TOWN ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - The Committee says the Games will help unite South Africans in post-Apartheid transition. Full government support although local poll results inconclusive.

VENUES - Some sites will help economic development. The Committee says the Games would increase employment and help social advancement. Good conditions for most venues. The general concept makes good use of South Africa's business community. A 75,000-seat Olympic Stadium will be built within walking distance of the village.
FACILITIES - Generally good revised plans.
WEAKNESSES:
ENVIRONMENT - Preliminary environmental studies needed.
SECURITY - Serious crime situation is a challenge.

TRANSPORT - Good basic infrastructure but many improvements needed, particularly for the airport and railways. Plans are thorough and detailed. Potential traffic congestion problem in the harbour and central business district needs to be addressed.
CAPACITY - A 45 percent growth in hotel capacity foreseen.
5,000 existing and planned four-five star hotel rooms.
BUDGET - Sponsorship and ticket sales revenues on the high side
LEGISLATION - New pieces of legislation needed.
*** ROME ***
STRENGTHS:
LOCAL SUPPORT - Latest poll shows 81 percent of the city's population supports the bid and 97 percent are aware of it.
VENUES - Excellent and professional plans. Some sites in historic locations. Good conditions foreseen for most venues. Existing 85,000-seat stadium.
FACILITIES - High-quality village plan.
ENVIRONMENT - Wide support for the environmental plan.
ACCOMMODATION - Excellent with 6,800 rooms out of 15,440 existing four-five star rooms offered.
BUDGET - Thorough and detailed. Revenues appear high.
WEAKNESSES:
TRANSPORT - Traffic major problem but improvements planned.
*** STOCKHOLM ***
STRENGTHS:
VENUES - Good conditions for most venues. 70,000-seat stadium within walking distance of the village.
ENVIRONMENT - Tied into the city's environmental plans and ecologiclly sustainable.
ACCOMMODATION - Fully met by the region's vast network of 107,916 existing and 8,600 future planned rooms.
TRANSPORT - Reliable and extensive public transport
HEALTH - Excellent and well-staffed facilities. Advanced anti-doping programme.
TELECOMMUNICATIONS - High technological standards.
BUDGET - Transparent. Financial guarantees are high quality.
WEAKNESSES:
LOCAL SUPPORT - 52 percent of population oppose the bid on ecological and environmental concerns. But the Committee claims more and more Swedes are now supporting the bid.
